title: tetraena aegyptia
intro: Tetraena aegyptia, commonly known as Egyptian Rue, is a flowering plant species found in the deserts of North Africa and the Middle East. It is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties which have shown to provide relief from pain and swelling. The bioactive constituents present in the plant, such as alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-cancer properties. The health benefits of Egyptian Rue include its use in reducing fever, treating respiratory issues, and providing antioxidant protection against oxidative stress.
